p.src: 2  “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

en: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.
u.src: 2  “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

p.src: 3  Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

en: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?
u.src: 3  Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

p.src: 4  How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

en: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?
u.src: 4  How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

p.src: 5  Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

en: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;
u.src: 5  Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

p.src: 6  How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”
